name: ai-video-skills
description: Skills for producing short social-media videos end-to-end with kie.ai + ElevenLabs + Wan 2.6 + HyperFrames

plugins.name: ai-video-skills
plugins.description: Four sub-skills covering: (1) project setup on rolling-release Linux with HyperFrames + sharp; (2) word-by-word closed captions (TikTok-pop and karaoke styles, Whisper vs Scribe); (3) asset generation via kie.ai images + ElevenLabs voice/music/SFX + Wan 2.6 image-to-video animation + Luna CDN hosting; (4) composition workflow with HyperFrames (img+video+audio multi-track, watermark rotation, fade-to-black, URL typewriter, platform safe-zones for WhatsApp Stories / IG Reels / FB).
